links.outcome: Share of LLM-generated summaries meeting target 6th-8th grade reading level
links.effect: Five of 10 PLSs met the target 6th-8th grade reading level; the other five did not. Passive voice averaged 16%.
links.quote: Five PLSs met the target 6th-8th grade reading level.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt development and refinement to specify plain language, reading level, length, and structure for LLM summaries
Human review of LLM-drafted plain language summaries of evidence reviews for accuracy and comprehensiveness

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility and quality (accuracy, readability, comprehensiveness) of Claude 2 generating plain language summaries of clinical evidence reviews using prompt engineering, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard comparatively.
